uncontrolled_pause_reload_attempt.next_control: Reload same state under a future-frame input script that owns port0 but publishes neutral input throughout the run. Do not treat the first failure as a confirmed runtime bug or silently discard it.
uncontrolled_pause_reload_attempt.neutral_control_result: PASS: same paused state, forced neutral port0, 241 identical scene-clock samples and exactly zero delta. Normal resume case also passed.
uncontrolled_pause_reload_attempt.cause_of_uncontrolled_resume: Not established: original run did not capture input/focus; cannot prove which key/event caused it. Production pause/reload bug not established by this run.

limitations: Queue quantum is a demonstrated contributor, not a complete explanation of frame tails. Acquiring/presenting surface is short in these diagnostic samples; prior GS preparation and host scheduling still matter.
Three pairs and uncontrolled host load do not establish causation of each small loss/gain; negative and outlier windows remain retained. No threshold rounding or post-hoc waiver.
Software API presentation timestamps are not GPU completion, scanout, physical audio underruns or input-to-photon latency.
Requested256 is not a guarantee of hardware period; observed dequeue differences can combine callbacks.
No sample values/resampling/physics/guest clock/shader/hazard/queue-atomic or production-default change retained.
No new playable v18 package, image matrix,36routes or PCM-equality claim after failed gate. Original v17 package/save remains current.

The automated checkpoint replay does not finish a race: separate end-state capture shows position8/8 and lap1/2. Human keyboard victory is directly reported by the maintainer; result-screen/save/readback is not independently verified. Separate human sessions are not a continuous30minute run.

Human scene-clock spans are0.9562 and0.9358 times wall time despite near60 simulated FPS. Active flag/delta gates exist in generated guest code; this field is not player race/result time. Original cadence, intentional time scaling and the source of the difference remain unresolved; no fixed slowdown or controller causation claim.

Seven new automated native checks cover three30-second active segments, separate pause/reload/resume and an effects segment. Serialization adds a pause and these are descriptive diagnostics, not paired FPS or full-race driving validation.
Original PS2 parity, aliasing, real audio/input, second Windows/GPU and provenance/CI/distribution remain open. GitHub only documentation/metrics; PR23 stays open and main unchanged.
